Markets.title: Global Market Today: Asian stocks fall as AI trade doubts resurface
Markets.summary: Asian stocks fell, led by a 3.7% decline in South Korea's Kospi index, reversing previous gains. The market downturn was driven by resurfacing doubts regarding the artificial intelligence trade.

Markets.title: Nasdaq, S&P 500 end lower as investors assess Jensen Huang's return to Nvidia
Markets.summary: The Nasdaq and S&P 500 fell due to declining tech shares and investor concerns over potential new tariffs, while the Dow Jones Industrial Average gained. The market drop occurred despite the reinstatement of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, which had previously spurred a rally.

Markets.title: PE/VC investments in India surge to USD 8.7 billion in October, highest monthly level in five years: EY-IVCA report
Markets.summary: Private equity and venture capital investments in India surged to USD 8.7 billion in October 2026, marking the highest monthly level in five years. This growth was driven by eight large deals, with financial services attracting the majority of the funding at USD 5.9 billion.

Markets.title: Shift in pension and insurance money to equities dampens long-term G-sec demand: RBI DG
Markets.summary: Demand for long-term government securities has declined as insurance companies and pension funds shift their investments toward equities. The Reserve Bank of India states this trend impacts market stability and highlights challenges in liquidity distribution.

Markets.title: A 50 bps jumbo rate hike can lead to financial stability concerns, hurt growth: Report
Markets.summary: SBI economists lowered their expected Reserve Bank of India rate hike from 0.50 percent to 0.25 percent for the upcoming December meeting. This adjustment aims to prevent financial stability risks and protect economic growth.

Markets.title: IIFCL IPO: Govt to part sale stake, company to issue fresh shares
Markets.summary: The government plans to sell part of its stake in India Infrastructure Finance Company Ltd (IIFCL) through an upcoming initial public offering (IPO). The company will also issue fresh shares, with the IPO expected by the end of the current fiscal year.

Geo-Political.title: US attorney general dodges questions about Nvidia investigation
Geo-Political.summary: Nvidia's share price dropped 7% after the US attorney general avoided answering lawmakers' questions regarding an investigation. Lawmakers are demanding answers about President Donald Trump's involvement in the reinstatement of CEO Jensen Huang.

Geo-Political.title: French ex-President Sarkozy and wife Carla Bruni to face trial
Geo-Political.summary: Former French President Nicolas Sarkozy and his wife, Carla Bruni, are scheduled to stand trial. This development follows Sarkozy becoming the first former French president to be imprisoned last year.

Geo-Political.title: Indian government has 'lost the plot', says 'cockroach' leader barred from UK flight
Geo-Political.summary: Indian immigration authorities barred Saurav Das from a UK-bound flight after flagging his passport at Delhi airport. Das responded by criticizing the Indian government and calling a leader a "cockroach."

Geo-Political.title: Huawei found guilty of stealing trade secrets but acquitted of racketeering
Geo-Political.summary: Following a months-long trial in New York, a court found Huawei guilty of stealing trade secrets. However, the company was acquitted of racketeering charges.

Geo-Political.title: Land mine casualties soar in Syria, two years after war
Geo-Political.summary: Two years after the war in Syria, land mine casualties have surged significantly. Nearly 1,000 children are among those who have been killed or injured by these leftover explosives.

Geo-Political.title: Nigerian monarch, 92, suspended after sexual assault claims
Geo-Political.summary: Nigeria has suspended the 92-year-old Emir of Daura following accusations of sexual assault. The monarch is one of the country's most prominent traditional rulers.

AI & Tech.title: REA: The Open-Source AI Tool That Can Reverse Engineer Almost Anything (2026 Guide)
AI & Tech.summary: REA is a new open-source AI tool that allows users to understand how applications work without accessing their source code. The tool eliminates the need to spend months learning disassemblers and reading assembly code.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator discovered their WordPress SaaS course was recommended as the top result when they asked ChatGPT for the best course on the subject. The author achieved this visibility without paying for advertising.

AI & Tech.summary: This article highlights the top ten essential artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These tools aim to help digital creators stay ahead of industry trends and streamline their workflows.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their work.

Data & Insights.title: Hiccups! Why Scotch whisky is caught in a tariff row and shipments are being seized | Explained amid India-UK trade deal
Data & Insights.summary: India has reaffirmed its tariff commitments under the India-UK trade deal despite a classification dispute involving Scotch whisky. This dispute has resulted in over 80 containers being held at ports, with potential duties reaching 162.5%.

Data & Insights.title: Explained | While US-China agreement offers trade relief, why firms may not reverse their costly supply-chain moves
Data & Insights.summary: China has extended its suspension of export restrictions on key minerals to the United States until January 27, 2027, easing immediate supply concerns. However, businesses that invested in costly alternative suppliers to avoid previous disruptions are likely to keep those backups despite the new agreement.

Data & Insights.title: US prepares fresh tariff hikes on China and India over industrial subsidies; announcement expected this week
Data & Insights.summary: The Trump administration is preparing new tariffs on China, India, and 15 other economies due to industrial subsidies. An official announcement detailing the higher duties for these countries is expected this week.

Data & Insights.title: States raise  ₹7 trillion in market borrowings so far in FY27, 12% below plan
Data & Insights.summary: Indian states have raised ₹7 trillion through market borrowings in fiscal year 2027, which is 12% below their planned target. Uttar Pradesh, West Bengal, and Karnataka drove nearly 62% of this borrowing increase while the central government reduced its own borrowing program.

Data & Insights.title: More credit, but large gaps: the challenge ahead for Mudra and Stand-Up India push
Data & Insights.summary: The government has extended Mudra and Stand-Up India credit guarantees for another five years to maintain small-business funding. However, persistent issues such as skewed beneficiary shares, rising loan sizes, and repayment stress raise concerns about truly inclusive growth.

Data & Insights.title: India-UK trade deal cuts Scotch whisky duty to 75%, but bulk imports face 110% levy; govt working to resolve dispute
Data & Insights.summary: An India-UK trade deal reduces the duty on bottled Scotch whisky to 75%, but high-strength bulk spirits imported for blending still face a 110% levy. The Indian government is currently working to resolve this ongoing dispute over bulk imports.

India.title: Nepal PM Balen Shah's India Visit Marks New Chapter In Ties, Says Brother-In-Law
India.summary: Nepal Prime Minister Balen Shah's brother-in-law stated that Shah's India visit marks a new chapter in bilateral relations. Sejekan also highlighted that Shah's political rise is remarkable due to his lack of a political dynasty or traditional backing.

India.title: Kerala Student Carrying Gun To 'Show Off' Accidentally Shoots Classmate
India.summary: A student in Kerala accidentally shot a classmate in the bicep after bringing a gun to school to show off. The injured student is currently undergoing surgery to have the bullet removed.

India.title: Akhilesh Yadav's Open Letter, Then A Move That Overlaps Congress Wishlist
India.summary: The Congress party is seeking one hundred seats in the upcoming seat-sharing arrangement. However, the Samajwadi Party is only willing to allocate 26 seats.

India.title: Amid Deepam Row, Thiruparankundram Temple Says It Stood By Tradition
India.summary: The Thiruparankundram temple board stated that the ceremonial lamp was lit at 6 PM at its traditional location atop the Uchipillayar Deepa Mandapam hillock. This action followed a unanimous resolution to uphold established worship practices amid the Deepam controversy.

India.title: FSSAI Scrutiny Limited To One Goa Batch, Now Out Of Circulation: Bisleri
India.summary: Bisleri stated that FSSAI's recent scrutiny in Goa was limited to a single product batch that is no longer in circulation. The company confirmed that its Goa facility has not suspended operations and that newer production samples comply with food safety standards.

India.title: Focus On Disgruntled Leaders As BJP Preps For UP Assembly Polls
India.summary: The BJP is preparing for the Uttar Pradesh assembly polls by focusing on disgruntled leaders and party workers. Dialogues will be held with senior leaders at the local unit, block, and assembly-constituency levels as part of this initiative.

General.title: Nuclear test veterans will get full truth, says Burnham, as he confirms independent panel
General.summary: The prime minister confirmed that an independent panel will investigate the health impacts of Britain's Cold War atomic tests. This Hillsborough-style review aims to provide nuclear test veterans with the full truth regarding their medical legacy.

General.title: Nuclear test veterans speak to BBC about search for justice
General.summary: Andy Burnham announced an investigation into the health impacts of Britain's Cold War atomic programme on nuclear test veterans. Veterans spoke to the BBC about their ongoing search for justice and the truth regarding their health legacy.

General.summary: The United States is preparing to introduce new tariffs affecting major trading partners worldwide. The upcoming levies will target several key economies, including China and the European Union.
